caveat: Manual inventory includes 6 issue acceptance bullets; canonical extractor recognizes 3. CI green and internal evidence do not represent independent auditor approval.

acceptance_criteria.text: Restrict both canonical URL forms and verify app, check, external ID, SHA; deny spoofed URLs.
Retain newly-created ID on failure and terminate it as failure.
Surface closure errors and never claim approval.
Execute positive, negative, regression tests in bootstrap CI.
Authenticated recovery of known orphaned checks without retrying failed jobs.
Develop base, no merge ahead of genuinely separate review.
